dissonance: After a game ends, the Play Again button and Space shortcut behave a little differently: restarting no longer runs through a single reset routine, so the new game may start with a slightly different pause or reset state, though the button and its label look the same.

metric.name: play_again_click
metric.description: Counts how often players click the Play Again button (or press Space) after the game-over screen is shown, divided by how many times the game-over screen was shown.
